title: Pulse Dash
author: cobanov
description: A neon rhythm runner: your cube slides to a synthesized beat, and every spike, block, pad and ring sits on the music. Three levels, one touch and you start again.

controls.D-pad: Left / right: choose a level · UP: jump
controls.A: Jump (hold to keep jumping), jump again on rings, start
controls.B: Back to title (paused, after a crash or a finished level)
